name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer with a strategic land position and royalty interests in Nevada's historic high-grade mining districts. The company holds a 50% earn-in interest in the Lapon Canyon Project, located within the prolific Walker Lane shear zone approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada, which hosts historical high-grade underground workings. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage, having recently completed a reverse circulation drill program at Lapon Canyon targeting high-grade gold mineralization.
